question: In the INREV Due Diligence Questionnaire 2022 for Funds of Funds and Multi Manager, when was the FoF / MM questionnaire originally launched, what two additions appear at the front of the DDQ, and how long may the manager's statement be?
expected_facts: The INREV FoF / MM DDQ was originally launched in 2014 as a variation of the INREV DDQ for Non-Listed Real Estate Investment Vehicles (most recently updated in 2018). The two additions at the front are (i) a Vehicle Fact Sheet, a snapshot of basic high-level vehicle information, and (ii) a Funds of Funds / Multi Manager Statement, where the manager showcases its platform and expertise. The statement should be short, no more than one page.
acceptance: 2014, both additions, and no more than one page suffice. April 2007 is protocol launch, not this questionnaire's launch.

prior_reviews.reason: The supplied document describes itself as the first version of the questionnaire, not the specified 2022 edition. Its April 2007 date refers to the due diligence protocol, not the FoF / MM questionnaire. It does not state the requested launch year, identify the two front-of-DDQ additions, or give a page limit for the manager’s statement.
quotes: The Due Diligence Questionnaire for Fund of Funds and Multi-Managers is part of the due diligence protocol which was first launched in April 2007.
This is the first version of the questionnaire.
